data.title: Wabi-sabi
data.tagline: Use natural material, space, and asymmetry to create a quiet pace
data.description: Wabi-sabi-inspired web design draws from natural color, material texture, negative space, and hand-made variation to acknowledge time and imperfection. It is not one brand's style or a fixed beige-and-serif template. Real content, photography, and material should guide the choices.

use: Essay or personal blog focused on long reading
avoid: Reduce scan efficiency in a data-heavy tool
Add saturated accents with no clear role
Use large empty areas without careful type and material detail
Interrupt the quiet rhythm with constant promotion labels

data.agentPrompt: Wabi-sabi tea journal, warm paper texture, gray-brown ink, asymmetric whitespace, delicate serif type, hand-formed ceramic material, slow-reading paragraphs, brewing log and continue-writing action, one restrained vermilion seal
